__SETUP_INSTRUCTIONS__: 2. Create a new project (or use an existing one)
3. Add an Android app with package name: com.bookreader
4. Download google-services.json and replace this file
5. In Firebase Console > Authentication: enable Google sign-in
6. In Firebase Console > Firestore: create a database, use these security rules:
allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
7. Copy your Web Client ID from Firebase Console > Authentication > Sign-in method > Google
